info.title: Where to Start With Tinnitus
info.subtitle: Practical steps that beat waiting it out

rows.title: Get a hearing test
rows.desc: Tinnitus often signals hearing change worth checking

rows.title: Rule out earwax
rows.desc: Removing a wax blockage can settle the ringing

rows.title: Try sound therapy
rows.desc: Gentle sound makes tinnitus less prominent over time

rows.title: Consider a therapy program
rows.desc: Counseling and sound plans, sometimes Lenire

rows.title: Know the red flags
rows.desc: Sudden, one-sided, or pulsing? Get seen promptly
